title: Pippi Longstocking and the horse on the porch.
lines: In a little town there's an old, colourful house.
A very special girl lives there.
Pippi has red plaits that stick straight out sideways.
She has freckles on her nose.
And she wears two different stockings.
Pippi lives all on her own.
She lives with a little monkey, Mr Nilsson.
The horse lives on the porch!
Pippi is the strongest girl in the world.
She can lift her horse with her arms.
Two children live next door to Villa Villekulla.
They're always very neat and well behaved.
She's walking backwards down the street.
Tommy and Annika become her best friends.
She throws the egg high into the air.
She scrubs the floor by tying brushes under her feet.
One day a circus comes to town.
Whoever can beat me gets a hundred euros!
And she puts him down gently.
But what does she do with it?
For all the children in town.
They hand out the sweets in the square.
That evening Tommy, Annika and Pippi sit on the porch.
Pippi, will you grow up one day?
And I'll always do whatever I want.
She swings her legs and sings a song.
